data.body: Cross-epic ownership correction (2026-09-07): this story's claim that it edits exactly `docs/README.md:130` and `:142` and that "every other line belongs to the docs epic" is contradicted by two concurrent stories: courageous-charcoaly-wrasse (overlap epic) edits the same line `:142` (one sentence carrying four `calibration/` links, including `overlap_batch_confidence.md`, which it deletes), and dendriform-amethyst-hoopoe (editor epic) edits `:79`. Rule for `:142`: this story repoints the surviving links to `evals/calibration/`; the overlap story removes its one link; whichever lands second re-applies its edit to the sentence as it then stands. Also `tests/unit/test_check_criteria_vocabulary.py`: this story edits `:168,212`, the editor story `:169`, the MCP derivation story `:324-326`, and the test-suite story deletes one test; all disjoint, rebase-trivial.
